Made fresh on Broadway

Las Chiquitas is a neighborhood Mexican kitchen in the heart of Redwood City. Everything is cooked to order, from sizzling fajitas and slow-cooked chile verde to fresh aguas frescas and smoothies.

Come hungry on Wednesdays for our posole, a hearty hominy pork soup with cabbage and onion.
